mapper.select: select from spot_reservation_visitor where reservation_no = #{reservationNo} order by booker desc, id asc
mapper.insert:
insert into spot_reservation_visitor ( order_id, reservation_no, user_id, scenic_area_id, spot_id, slot_id, visit_date, real_name, id_card_masked, id_card_hash, booker, status, create_time, update_time ) values
( #{visitor.orderId}, #{visitor.reservationNo}, #{visitor.userId}, #{visitor.scenicAreaId}, #{visitor.spotId}, #{visitor.slotId}, #{visitor.visitDate}, #{visitor.realName}, #{visitor.idCardMasked}, #{visitor.idCardHash}, #{visitor.booker}, #{visitor.status}, #{visitor.createTime}, #{visitor.updateTime} )
mapper.update: update spot_reservation_visitor set status = 'CANCELLED', update_time = now() where reservation_no = #{reservationNo} and status in ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED')
